Summary: As a student, I want to register and log in so that I can access the portal.
Description: Acceptance criteria: unique email creates an account; invalid values are rejected; login establishes a session; public registration cannot grant TPO.

Summary: As a student, I want to create and update my profile so recruiters can view my qualifications.
Description: Acceptance criteria: student can update academic details and skills; server validates fields; other students cannot modify this profile.

Summary: As a student, I want to upload my résumé so recruiters can review it.
Description: Acceptance criteria: accept PDF DOC or DOCX within size limit; reject invalid type; owner downloads or removes; access checks are enforced.

Summary: As a recruiter, I want to create and publish job posts so eligible students can apply.
Description: Acceptance criteria: required fields validate; recruiter sees only own roles; published roles appear in student discovery.

Summary: As a student, I want to browse and filter jobs so I can find suitable opportunities.
Description: Acceptance criteria: search title company and skills; filters apply; reset and no-results states work.

Summary: As a student, I want to apply for jobs so recruiters can consider me.
Description: Acceptance criteria: eligible signed-in student submits once; duplicate is rejected; confirmation and application date are visible.

Summary: As a student, I want to track application status so I know my progress.
Description: Acceptance criteria: only own applications are visible; status history is chronological; current status is prominent.

Summary: As a recruiter, I want to review applicants and shortlist candidates.
Description: Acceptance criteria: recruiter sees applicants to own roles; can filter and update status; student receives an update.

Summary: As a recruiter, I want to schedule interviews for shortlisted candidates.
Description: Acceptance criteria: only own shortlisted applicants can be scheduled; date mode and location or link validate; student is notified.

Summary: As a student, I want interview notifications so I do not miss conversations.
Description: Acceptance criteria: schedule reschedule and cancellation appear in unread list with time and application context.

Summary: As a TPO, I want to view student placement status so I can monitor campus progress.
Description: Acceptance criteria: TPO sees student status; department and year filters apply; unauthorized users are denied.

Summary: As a TPO, I want to generate placement reports so I can analyze outcomes.
Description: Acceptance criteria: totals match filtered records; CSV has headings; empty report is handled.

Summary: As a TPO, I want to manage recruiter accounts so only trusted recruiters post jobs.
Description: Acceptance criteria: TPO sees verification state; approval actions are audited; recruiter cannot change verification.

Summary: As a student, I want application update notifications so I can respond promptly.
Description: Acceptance criteria: status transition creates unread notification; timestamp and context appear; mark-all-read works.

Summary: As a TPO, I want to publish placement announcements for students.
Description: Acceptance criteria: TPO publishes validated notice; target audience receives it; author and date are recorded.
